summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for SortIQ PureStream OS & Web Portal, an industrial-grade and source-segregation waste sorting sensor ecosystem. Outlines the dual-interface architecture (Industrial MRF Telemetry and Guidance Terminal), real-time NIR/RGB/load-cell sensor simulator with sub-50ms actuator triggering, anti-wishcycling interception rules, downstream circularity lifecycle roadmaps, and hardware calibration diagnostics.
